ADF Group signs $602M contract, largest in company's history
stories.summary: ADF Group Inc. says it has signed a $602-million contract in the northeastern United States, the company's largest contract ever in terms of volume and value. The maker of steel superstructures says the project will require about $10 million in capital investment at its plant in Terrebonne, Que.

Toronto sees another stretch of warm weather with temperatures in mid-teens
stories.summary: Toronto and the surrounding areas are getting another stretch of unusually warm weather in the middle of fall. Environment Canada is forecasting clear and sunny weather and temperatures hitting 13 degrees on Tuesday in Toronto.
